steps.title: Cru learns your routines
steps.body: Ask Cru for the same few things again, a morning check say, and it saves how it did it as a routine: next time the words are enough, and the routine gets better each time. When a conversation is compacted, Cru also looks back over it and updates what it knows about you and how you like it to be.

steps.title: Unread from Cru
steps.body: When Cru has something to tell you and no screen is open, it keeps it in its conversation instead of the inbox, and a red dot appears on its mark. Open Cru's chat view to read it; a notification takes you straight there.
